changes: Replace custom photo steps and all photo overlay arrows with a nested native horizontal scroll-snap carousel. Passive touch observation never prevents defaults or changes index on touchend.
One animated indicator per photo, including a single photo and larger albums. Active opacity/scale follows native scroll; reduced-motion disables transitions.
Initial one image per card; adjacent slides warm only upon explicit interaction, floor/ceil slides load during native scroll.
Price-only updates preserve DOM, fractional offsets and browser inertia. Selected URL restores after resize, hidden rendering and inventory identity changes.
Current owner and bounded current inventory entry/media validated per coalesced animation frame; stale profiles, media, sold lots and detached callbacks rejected.
Mixed pointerup/touchend order preserves normal taps; outside mouse release cannot leave resize blocked.
Prepare disabled server-only Telegram/MAX notification adapters, no live bots, webhook endpoints or outbound messages.

integration_tests.telegram: node integrations/telegram/adapter.test.cjs PASS with fake transport only
integration_tests.max: node integrations/max/adapter.test.cjs PASS with fake transport only
integration_tests.independent_review: Old /stop after relinking and MAX arbitrary text forwarding reproduced independently, fixed and rechecked; paused/sent delivery claims and unknown outcomes constrained by repository contract.

validation_scope: 36 targeted top-level files (all featured-* and security-*), plus 2 isolated server-adapter test files. Not all 204 top-level test files were rerun.

build.android_signature: APK v2 verified; demo debug build.

first_attempt_failures: Three failures were resolved: skip needless gallery lookup for one-photo cards in two lightweight fixtures, and assert visible price DOM rather than static mock innerHTML after price-only patch. Repeated suite passed 36/36 on unchanged source.
next_stages: Messages UI and local drafts, listing entitlements, public bank following and legal copyright revision are being prepared in separate worktrees. They are not included in this runtime.
limits: No physical iPhone/Android or emulator is available: actual browser/OS RAM and physical gestures were not measured. Device evidence: docs/device-memory-audit-2026-11-14.md.
Official eBay/W3C references inform the pattern; no live marketplace browser/device QA was performed.
This is an authenticated demo with browser-local auction state, not protected shared bank accounts/real payment escrow/live chat or a tested high-concurrency auction backend.
Telegram/MAX modules are disabled scaffolding. Real provider onboarding, secrets, server identity, durable store/outbox and confirmed bot URLs are still required; no QR is fabricated.
No end-to-end encryption is planned per user; TLS, access control, storage/backups and key protection remain separate requirements.
